This report offers a comprehensive view of the dynamic cloud adoption landscape in the financial services sector, focusing on key aspects such as cloud strategy, governance, regulation, and data.

In this interview series, we explore the second edition of the 'Cloud in Financial Services' report. This update revisits our research with financial institutions, focusing on the unique challenges faced by financial entities in the EU, Switzerland, and the UK.
